task.title: Package and validate the new 0.1.30 portable executable containing the awkit-lgn2 login redesign
task.objective: Produce the next semantic version (0.1.30) portable executable via the documented next-release wrapper (scripts/release-portable.ps1 -BumpType patch) from clean source a1ceef9, which contains the awkit-lgn2 pre-auth redesign commits 242b800..efef652; capture binding provenance (treeDirty false, exact source SHA, artifact size/SHA-256); pass verify:packaged-validation inside its freshness window; launch the exact new executable via packaged-runtime and packaged-walkthrough; report packaged-licensing truthfully where the external issuer key gates it; reconcile project state; commit and push normally.

compatibility: Do not modify renderer/product source unless the packaged artifact exposes a genuine defect.

The version moves 0.1.29 -> 0.1.30 only through the documented next-release wrapper (scripts/release-portable.ps1 -BumpType patch), which synchronizes package.json + package-lock.json and commits the signed manifest pair itself.
Portable target only this run; no installer build requested.
The prior 0.1.29 artifacts (portable caee4db6, installer 914ec122) predate the login redesign and remain STALE for proving the new pre-auth surface.
offline: Packaging stays offline; no dependency changes; signing key handling follows verify:release-key-custody.

acceptance.description: A new-version portable executable (SpecterStudio 0.1.30.exe) is generated during this task from clean source containing the awkit-lgn2 redesign, with provenance recording treeDirty false, the exact source SHA, and artifact filename/size/SHA-256 matching disk.

verify:packaged-validation fully passes inside its freshness window on the 0.1.30 artifact; the exact new executable launches with appMode=packaged (packaged-runtime, packaged-walkthrough) with only the documented external-gate BLOCKEDs (issuer key).
awkit-v130 closed and exported, project state reconciled (ledger unchanged unless a real ledger case moved), roadmap Sources agree, work committed to main and pushed normally, worktree clean.
